title: Copper Legion Keep
subtitle: Zaikhal keep, 35 Viamontian Man-at-Arms for the kill task

notes.title: Legion Door not needed
notes.body: The locked Legion Door (key dropped by the Doorkeeper) leads past every Man-at-Arms spawn, so you can ignore it and the lever.

notes.title: Use fire or lightning
notes.body: Man-at-Arms take 120% from fire and lightning, 90% from bludgeon and cold, and only 80% from slash and pierce.

notes.title: Respawn
notes.body: 35 Man-at-Arms here, and they come back about every 2 minutes. One clear gets you 35, so wait for the respawn or add Silver Legion Keep to reach 50.
